model: Sunny Tripower Storage X and Sunny Island X
description: Remote control of Sunny Tripower Storage X and Sunny Island X systems over Modbus TCP: identity, nominal powers, operating status, battery state of charge, active power limits and setpoints, battery charge and discharge power, and fallback settings
source: SMA, SMA Modbus Interface, Remote Control – Sunny Tripower Storage X / Sunny Island X, technical information SMAModbus-STPS-X-SI-X-TI-en-11, version 1.1

sources.title: SMA Modbus Interface – Remote Control – Sunny Tripower Storage X / Sunny Island X

notes: Modbus TCP only, port 502, through the device configured as System Manager. Read with function 04 (03 also works on SMA devices), write with 16. Addresses are SMA's decimal register numbers as sent.
Unit ID 1 is the communication product, 2 the system and 3 each device; every entry gives the unit IDs it answers on. The map's unit_id is 3.

For external battery control on unit ID 3, the manual sets 40210 = 1079, 41195 = 10 and 44029 = 303, disables the energy management of the System Manager, and then sends 44449 and 44451 together (four registers) at regular intervals. The external system then takes over battery protection.
Values are 32-bit, high word first; FIX1 to FIX3 formats have that many decimals.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Serial number
registers.description: Returns the serial number of a device. Unit ID 1. Format RAW.

registers.name: Device category
registers.description: Returns a key figure from the tag list that indicates the device category (e.g. 8009 – Hybrid inverter). Unit ID 1. Format ENUM.

registers.name: Nominal active power WMaxOutRtg
registers.description: Returns the nominal active power of the grid feedin, e.g. 50,000 W Unit ID 2. Format FIX0.

registers.name: Operating mode active power controller
registers.description: Sets the standard regulation mode, default: 3352 (open-loop control). Unit ID 2. Format TAGLIST.

registers.name: Limitation of active power in %
registers.description: Returns the limitation in percent. Two decimals, range: 0–10,000, default: 10,000 (100%). Unit ID 2. Format FIX2.

registers.name: Current state of health; 5-minute value; device sta- tus Returns a key figure from the tag list that indicates the state of the device or system.
registers.description: Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format TAGLIST.

registers.name: Accumulated connected power of the PV inverter
registers.description: (W) Sets the active power limit, e.g. 50,000 W for an STPS 50-20. No decimal offset (FIX0), unit: watt. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX0.

registers.name: Current battery state of charge (SOC in relation to present capacity), in % Returns the state of charge (SOC) of a single battery (Unit ID 3) in percent, without decimal offset. This value is the "User SOC", i.e. the actual SOC minus the upper and lower charging/discharging limits.
registers.description: Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX0.

registers.name: Nominal active power WMaxInRtg, in W
registers.description: Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX0.

registers.name: Quick shut-down of the inverters
registers.description: Allows quick disconnection of the system (Unit ID 2) or of individual devices (Unit ID 3) by sending tags: Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format ENUM.

registers.name: General operating status
registers.description: Returns the general operating status: Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format TAGLIST.

registers.name: Nominal battery capacity
registers.description: Returns the nominal capacity in watt hours (Wh) without decimal offset. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX0.

registers.name: Nominal grid voltage
registers.description: Returns the nominal grid voltage in volt, e.g. 230 V or 400 V. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX0.

registers.name: Behavior during failure of external setpoint
registers.description: Sets the fallback behavior: Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format TAGLIST.

registers.name: Timeout for external setpoint
registers.description: Sets the time in seconds (1 to 1,800s), default:                         TION 600s. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format DURA-.

registers.name: Activation threshold, grid feed-in
registers.description: Sets the activation threshold for grid feed-in. S32 with three decimals (FIX3), default: 5 %. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX3.

registers.name: Deactivation threshold grid feed-in
registers.description: Sets the deactivation threshold for grid feed-in. S32 with three decimals (FIX3), default: 5 %. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX3.

registers.name: Activation threshold power consumption
registers.description: Sets the activation threshold for power consumption. S32 with three decimals (FIX3), default: 5 %. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX3.

registers.name: Deactivation threshold power consumption
registers.description: Sets the deactivation threshold for power consumption. S32 with three decimals (FIX3), default: 5 %. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX3.

registers.name: Soft start rate P
registers.description: Indicates the soft start rate in %/min. Range: 1 to 10,000, default: 1,200 %/min. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX0.

registers.name: Soft start P after a grid fault
registers.description: Activates (308) or deactivates (303) the soft start after a grid fault. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format TAGLIST.

registers.name: Nominal active power WMaxOut
registers.description: Sets the nominal active power of the grid feed-in, e.g. 12,000 W. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX0.

registers.name: Nominal active power WMaxIn
registers.description: Sets the nominal active power of the intake, e.g. -60,000 W to 0 W. Unit IDs 2 and 3. Format FIX0.

registers.name: Operating status of battery
registers.description: Returns a key figure from the tag list that indicates the state of the battery: Unit ID 3. Format TAGLIST.

registers.name: Battery state of charge
registers.description: Returns a key figure from the tag list Unit ID 3. Format TAGLIST.

registers.name: Operating mode active power setpoint
registers.description: Sets the operating mode for the active power setpoint: Unit ID 3. Format TAGLIST.

registers.name: Active power limitation, in W
registers.description: Indicates an absolute limitation in watt. Unit ID 3. Format FIX0.

registers.name: Active power limitation in %
registers.description: Indicates a relative limitation in percent. Unit ID 3. Format FIX0.

registers.name: Operating mode of the BMS
registers.description: Sets the operating mode of the battery management system: Unit ID 3. Format TAGLIST.

registers.name: Maximum active power battery
registers.description: Important for battery control. S32 with two decimals (%), range: -10,000 % to 10,000. e.g. 3500 = 35 % of nominal power. Should be written at the same time as register 44451. Unit ID 3. Format FIX2.

registers.name: Minimum active power battery
registers.description: Important for battery control. S32 with two decimals (%), range: -10,000 % to 10,000. e.g. 3500 = 35 % of nominal power. Should be written at the same time as register 44449. Unit ID 3. Format FIX2.
